purpose: Evaluate actual host-declared area and independent-source quality proxies, no synthetic prices or observations
prior_knowledge: S02 and S02b development results previously observed. Parser and join audited on train without prices before fitting. Validation has been observed historically; this is not a fresh unbiased test.
split: unchanged host split; final test prohibited
base_hyperparameters: configs/s02_protocol.json candidate, unchanged; no parameter search

area.provenance: existing Inside Airbnb title/description; host declarations, not independent measurements
area.parser: src/staylens/enrichment.py frozen by run manifest before fit
area.exclude: ranges, sums, outdoor space, ambiguous scope, conflicting claims, Shared room
area.audit: 55 accepted claim snippets sampled seed42 and reviewed by assistant before training, without prices; not independent human validation

external_join.key: exact string Airbnb_ListingID, one-to-one; never float or geographic nearest match
external_join.checks: same host and room type, no known capacity/bedroom/bed/bathroom contradictions, scrape day <= Inside Airbnb last_scraped
external_join.quarantine: all external features unknown for unmatched or conflicting rows; original offer kept
external_join.date_caveat: calendar-day snapshot comparison; intraday order unknown
external_join.standard_caveat: Guest Favourite is a review/reliability badge, accessibility count is a listing attribute; neither is certified hotel stars or measured luxury
external_join.use: local research only; no external raw data or enriched public catalog released; free-content CC BY-NC-SA terms and raw-CSV scope require care before deployment

validation_gate.evaluate_only: CV winner and control if a new candidate passes; otherwise do not load validation
validation_gate.failure: retain S02, no second candidate or retuning

deployment: separate from experiment; keep S02 API and public catalog unchanged
